name: PrLogueXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: 16-voice poly synth modelled on the KORG prologue-16 (not affiliated with KORG): two VCOs, a multi engine (noise, 16 VPM types, KORG's logue-sdk waves oscillator), Poly/Duo/Mono/Unison/Chord, Main and Sub timbres, arpeggiator on MPC's grid, mod FX, delay/reverb and a low-frequency compressor with a live meter, over four pages.
